name: ES Opening Auction Center Migration v1
hypothesis: A directional opening move is accepted rather than merely transient when both the 09:59 close and the opening auction's volume-weighted price center migrate to the same side of the 09:30 open. Failed acceptance should return through that center quickly; accepted migration can persist into the afternoon.

rules.auction_center: volume-weighted mean of each one-minute bar's typical price, where typical price is (high + low + close) / 3
rules.long_signal: 09:59 close > 09:30 open and auction center > 09:30 open
rules.short_signal: 09:59 close < 09:30 open and auction center < 09:30 open
rules.entry: 10:00 open plus one adverse ES tick
rules.stop: auction center plus one adverse ES tick
rules.entry_validity: skip if the stop is not adverse to the simulated entry
rules.same_bar_rule: a stop touched anywhere in a one-minute bar is filled at the frozen stop price
rules.survivor_exit: 15:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
rules.position_limit: one MES contract, at most one trade per RTH session

economics.slippage_model: one adverse tick at entry; one adverse tick at the time exit; stop itself is placed one adverse tick beyond auction center

verdict: The mechanism is locally robust across nearby auction lengths and exit times, but the frozen holdout edge is economically fragile, 2025 is negative, and uncertainty includes zero. Preserve as a paper-trading candidate only; do not optimize to the favorable 60-minute result and do not deploy live.
